desc: **Parse input:** Read T, then for each test case read N, string A, string B. Collect positions (0-indexed) of 1's in A into list pA, and in B into list pB.
**Feasibility check:** If len(pA) != len(pB), answer is -1.
**Compute answer:** Iterate i from 0 to k-1, compute abs(pA[i] - pB[i]), track maximum. Output that maximum, or -1 if infeasible.
**Complexities:** O(N) per test case to collect positions; O(k) to compute max. Total N across test cases ≤ 10^6, well within limits.
**Output:** Print answer per test case, one per line. Use fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read / sys.stdout.write) to handle large input efficiently.
**Implement solve()** following the proposed steps, ensuring correct fast I/O and proper handling of edge cases.
